scope: external one-site stress test using metered Stanford 2022 controlled releases

label_contract.reason: The paper reports approximately 1 t/h as a best-case S2/Landsat detection boundary and explicitly treats the 4.95 kg/h Sentinel-2 release as a true negative. Intermediate releases remain a separate stress stratum.

product_contract.sentinel_2: exact public Level-1C acquisition within 180 seconds of the metered overpass
product_contract.landsat: exact USGS Collection 2 Level-1 Landsat 8/9 acquisition within 180 seconds of the metered overpass

role: external operating-point and no-plume stress test only
claim_boundaries: All observations belong to one physical site.
No paired site-block confidence interval or geographic generalization claim is possible.
This cohort cannot replace either official MARS-S2L evaluation view.
Subthreshold challenge observations do not enter primary positive/negative metrics.
outcome_sequence: Resolve and hash exact target products without model inference.
Freeze crop geometry, temporal-reference rule, model/checkpoint hashes, and operating threshold.
Acquire only required windows/bands into ignored storage.
Score each target once and report every scene plus primary confusion counts.
Report subthreshold observations separately without changing labels or thresholds.
